question: Does making evidence-driven, representation-dependent nearest-example review available to the genuine raw agent improve the model it freely delivers? The comparison follows a positive ten-fold development screen and is distinct from that screen.
control: A newly run ordinary integrated d45bdea agent with the complete 71-option discovery directory, 16 fit ceiling, 1800 seconds, raw course Task2 input and separate feature-only output. Never pass a model or scheduler hint.
new: Same API, fitting allowance, hardware, feature bank, raw input and time. A generic eligible preference problem with sufficient capacity can reserve up to six supervised fits for an optional challenge, while producing a deliverable first. Derive an executable neighbour option from the representation of the autonomously elected single incumbent, if supported. No benchmark lookup or preselected encoder. Unsupported or unresolved inputs retain the base. All label-bearing indices count as real fits. Save the already trained full incumbent rather than training it again.
decisions: Choose the neighbour weight solely on the primary training-held scores from 0, 0.25, 0.5 and 1, with ties favouring simpler retention. A positive weight must beat the incumbent on the primary fold. Lock the nominee, then require nonnegative change on each of two separately held training folds and at least +0.3 percentage points pooled on those confirmation rows before refitting the neighbour and deploying. Otherwise keep the original selected model. Write each decision and the measured rows before external prediction.
evaluation: Use one unchanged default control and one changed controller. Seal model/feature-only prediction hashes and independently reload each before examining the previously used designated school validation once if necessary. If a prediction exactly matches a previous seal, reuse the recorded score. Report all 940 row changes versus the equal-budget control and the established 10-fit 700/940 release. No tuning based on these 940, no H2 or final test. This study allows no language model API calls.
